    for lr in range(15,46):
        r=rc(i[site-lr:site]); tr=tm(r)
        if not 58<=tr<=72: continue
        if abs(tf-tr)>5: continue
        score=abs(tf-65)+abs(tr-65)+abs(tf-tr)
        if best is None or score<best[0]:
            best=(score,lf,lr,f,r,tf,tr)
print(best)
score,lf,lr,f,r,tf,tr=best
k=20
fwd=ins[k:]+f
rev=rc(ins[:k])+r

open('/app/primers.fasta','w').write(f'>insertion_fwd\n{fwd}\n>insertion_rev\n{rev}\n')
EOF
